name: En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why
label: Quest
description: En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Believe it or not, there are people out there willing to pay for the most vile of domesticated beast!
I'd sent Bijou into the Spire to try and collect some of those spire spider eggs but I haven't heard from her in weeks. Maybe you can help me out?
I'll tell you what, friend. Go to Blackrock Spire and collect some spire spider eggs for me. Bring them back here and not only will I give you a little cash, but I'll even domesticate one for you!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are those spider eggs in your pack or are you just happy to see me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: What a load! I mean, look at all those eggs! These should bring in a right few gold.
As promised, here's your own little critter. Don't get bitten!
